Guardians of the Nocturne - character art catalogue

Every character sprite, portrait and monster, rendered from the project's own art data (tools/art, tools/npc) with the hardware facts each one is built under. Images are scaled 3-4x nearest-neighbour; checkerboard = transparent. Colours are RGB444 (0-15 per channel).

Neo Geo Pocket Color limits

  • Screen 160x152 px; colour RGB444 (4096 colours).
  • Everything is 8x8 tiles, 2 bits per pixel: each tile uses one palette of 3 colours + transparent (index 0).
  • Black is the backdrop: transparent pixels show it, so black costs no palette slot where the backdrop is black.
  • Sprites: 64 OAM entries (8x8 each), 16 sprite palettes. Scroll planes SCR1 (front) and SCR2 (back): 16 palettes each, one per map cell.
  • Layering trick used here: a monster cell = SCR2 palette + SCR1 palette overlaid = up to 6 colours + black.

Contents

  • Hero (ARDEN) - 11
  • Townsfolk / NPCs - 27
  • Story faces (no townsfolk sprite) - 2
  • Composer portraits - 4
  • Monsters: Original realm - 9 families / 31 looks
  • Monsters: Nocturne Tower - 8 families / 16 looks
  • Monsters: Eastern Sea - 11 families / 24 looks
  • Monsters: The South - 15 families / 20 looks
  • Monsters: The South-East - 17 families / 20 looks
  • Bosses - 21 families / 21 looks

Gaps / notes

  • World-map figures (cast_world.py: cast designs remapped onto each sea set's SCR1 palettes as 16x16 BG pictures) are not catalogued separately - they are the cast designs above in world palettes.

Hero (ARDEN) (11)

ARDEN walks as a two-layer 16x16 sprite: the base sheet (GraphX/art/Fighter_Blue-Sheet_hw.png, 8 frames: down x2, right x2, left x2, up x2) whose blue cells are drawn on SPR palette ARD_BPAL 13 (black, armor main, skin), plus an overlay layer on SPR palette ARD_OPAL 14 (hair light, armor shade, armor trim) that only touches pixels already drawn by the base. field.c streams the current frame's 4 base + 4 overlay tiles (VRAM 320-327). Source: tools/art/arden_art.py, build_art.py hero().

Townsfolk / NPCs (27)

Townsfolk are 16x16 sprites (2x2 cells, 4 OAM), 8 frames (D D2 R R2 L L2 U U2; R/R2 are the H-flip of L/L2 via the sprite flip bit). Each 8x8 quadrant = black + at most 2 colours (one sprite palette). In-game, quadrants of all looks in a place are packed into SPR palettes 3-15 (the hero's 0-1 are reused when they fit) - the palette list below is the minimum packing for this look alone (greedy, as cast_lib/build_cast). Looks are cast_art.py designs + recolours (town_maps.LOOKS, incl. south/east/SE towns) and Workshop imports (tools/npc/gen/npc_imports.py, "@" designs). Tile count = unique quadrants with H-flip dedupe (build_cast dedupes against H-flip; actual indices depend on the place's palette packing).

Monsters: Original realm (9 families / 31 looks)

Battle monsters: one picture per family split by tools/art/twoplane.py into SCR2 (back, base) and SCR1 (front, detail); each layer has its own palette per 8x8 cell (3 colours + transparent), so a cell can show 6 colours + black backdrop. Regular families: max 48x72 px, 5 SCR2 + 4 SCR1 palettes; bosses up to 160x72, 16 + 13. Tiles load at VRAM 128-511. Each look (LOOK_*) = family tiles + its own colours.

Monsters: Nocturne Tower (8 families / 16 looks)

Battle monsters: one picture per family split by tools/art/twoplane.py into SCR2 (back, base) and SCR1 (front, detail); each layer has its own palette per 8x8 cell (3 colours + transparent), so a cell can show 6 colours + black backdrop. Regular families: max 48x72 px, 5 SCR2 + 4 SCR1 palettes; bosses up to 160x72, 16 + 13. Tiles load at VRAM 128-511. Each look (LOOK_*) = family tiles + its own colours.

Monsters: Eastern Sea (11 families / 24 looks)

Battle monsters: one picture per family split by tools/art/twoplane.py into SCR2 (back, base) and SCR1 (front, detail); each layer has its own palette per 8x8 cell (3 colours + transparent), so a cell can show 6 colours + black backdrop. Regular families: max 48x72 px, 5 SCR2 + 4 SCR1 palettes; bosses up to 160x72, 16 + 13. Tiles load at VRAM 128-511. Each look (LOOK_*) = family tiles + its own colours.

Monsters: The South (15 families / 20 looks)

Battle monsters: one picture per family split by tools/art/twoplane.py into SCR2 (back, base) and SCR1 (front, detail); each layer has its own palette per 8x8 cell (3 colours + transparent), so a cell can show 6 colours + black backdrop. Regular families: max 48x72 px, 5 SCR2 + 4 SCR1 palettes; bosses up to 160x72, 16 + 13. Tiles load at VRAM 128-511. Each look (LOOK_*) = family tiles + its own colours.

Monsters: The South-East (17 families / 20 looks)

Battle monsters: one picture per family split by tools/art/twoplane.py into SCR2 (back, base) and SCR1 (front, detail); each layer has its own palette per 8x8 cell (3 colours + transparent), so a cell can show 6 colours + black backdrop. Regular families: max 48x72 px, 5 SCR2 + 4 SCR1 palettes; bosses up to 160x72, 16 + 13. Tiles load at VRAM 128-511. Each look (LOOK_*) = family tiles + its own colours.

Bosses (21 families / 21 looks)

Battle monsters: one picture per family split by tools/art/twoplane.py into SCR2 (back, base) and SCR1 (front, detail); each layer has its own palette per 8x8 cell (3 colours + transparent), so a cell can show 6 colours + black backdrop. Regular families: max 48x72 px, 5 SCR2 + 4 SCR1 palettes; bosses up to 160x72, 16 + 13. Tiles load at VRAM 128-511. Each look (LOOK_*) = family tiles + its own colours.
